query:
SELECT c.id as courseId, c.title as courseTitle, c.level, COUNT(l.id) as lessonCount 
FROM courses c 
LEFT JOIN lessons l ON l.courseId = c.id 
WHERE c.languageId = 1 
GROUP BY c.id, c.title, c.level;
